1 (Acyclic Join [65]). A join Q = (x, {x𝑖 : 𝑖 ∈ [𝑚]}) is acyclic if one can organize its relations into a join tree T such that (1) there is a one-to-one correspondence between relations in Q and the nodes in T ; and (2) for each attribute 𝑥 ∈ x, the set of nodes containing 𝑥 forms a connected subtree.
